import sys, os, time, tempfile, subprocess, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('zig/pkg/antfly-grep/bench').resolve()))
from registered import Client
binary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
mode=sys.argv[2]
out=Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('ANTFLY_GREP_', 'RIPGREP_', 'JG_', 'GIT_CONFIG'))}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.zig-cache',prefix='work-profile-') as d:
    root=Path(d).resolve(); (root/'src').mkdir()
    for n in range(1000 if mode!='capture' else 100000):
        p=root/'src'/f'd{n%64:03}'/f'f{n:06}.txt';p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);p.write_text('STOP original\n')
    env.update(HOME=str(root),XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(root))
    if mode=='capture':
        proc=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'workspace','serve','--workspace-watch','--workspace-max-files=200000','--workspace-memory-limit=1G','src'],cwd=root,env=env,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(proc.pid),'2','1','-file',str(out)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        ready=proc.stdout.readline();proc.stdin.close();proc.wait(timeout=120);sampler.wait(timeout=20)
        print(ready.decode().strip());sys.exit()
    client=Client(binary,root,'src',[],env,start_args=['--workspace-watch'])
    _,rows=client.exchange('register',args=['STOP','--threads=2']);handle=rows[0]['query_handle']
    _,rows=client.exchange('search',revision=client.ready['revision'],query_handle=handle,delta=True,if_result_token='0'*64)
    token=next(r['result_token'] for r in rows if r['type']=='result_token')
    sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(client.process.pid),'3','1','-file',str(out)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    n=0;deadline=time.monotonic()+4
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        fields={}
        if mode=='delta':
            (root/'src'/'d000'/'f000000.txt').write_text(f'STOP {n}\n')
            client.exchange('refresh')
            fields.update(delta=True,if_result_token=token)
        _,rows=client.exchange('search',revision=client.ready['revision'],query_handle=handle,**fields)
        token=next(r['result_token'] for r in rows if r['type']=='result_token')
        n+=1
    sampler.wait(timeout=15);client.close()
    print(json.dumps(dict(mode=mode,requests=n,sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest())))
